snippet.title: Enginefall Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/2437390

Enginefall is a multiplayer extraction shooter set across a series of colossal megatrains — so it's a bit like Snowpiercer, with crafting! You and your friends can ride steel through the ruins of humanity (and salvage the best loot for your homebase) when it drops on PC in the near future, but there's a playtest live from June 8 to June 22 if you'd like to try it out for yourself.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
